groups.title: Plumbing
groups.summary: Full-service residential and commercial plumbing, from a slow drain to a whole-house repipe.
groups.intro: When you need first-rate plumbing services, look no further than 1-800-PLUMBER +AIR. We are always ready to handle your residential and commercial plumbing needs, and our professionals also do regular checks and inspections so that your plumbing system keeps running smoothly.
groups.imageAlt: A plumber working on the supply pipes behind a bathroom wall panel

services.title: Drain Cleaning
services.text: If your sink is always clogging, slow to drain and smelling strange, it is most likely time for a cleaning. If standing water is a regular sight, our technicians will have your drains flowing again.
points: Every drain in the home cleaned

services.title: Water Heaters
services.text: Whether there is water leaking from the bottom of your water heater, your water will not heat up or stay hot, or your water pressure is low, our plumbing team can help.

services.title: Tankless Water Heater
services.text: Tankless water heaters installed, repaired and maintained for homes that want hot water without a storage tank.

services.title: Water Leaks
services.text: Water damage on your floors and walls, puddles around your sinks and appliances and high water bills are all signs of a leak. Leaks can be small and easy to find, or in the pipes beneath your home.
points: Caught early before the damage spreads

services.title: Sewer Services
services.text: Cracks around your foundation, slow draining toilets or strange smells can mean a damaged sewer line, whether from tree roots or a buildup of objects in the line.
points: A sewer emergency can happen at any time

services.title: Water Treatment
services.text: Treating your water at home is better for your family's health, your appliances and the environment. Talk to a technician about an activated carbon water filter or a reverse osmosis filter in your home.
points: Filters out chlorine, microplastics and pesticides
Activated carbon filters, reverse osmosis systems and water softeners

services.title: Gas Lines
services.text: Gas piping work, including replacing gas or water lines to restore your plumbing or HVAC system.

services.title: Bathroom Plumbing
services.text: Installation and maintenance of the fixtures in your bathroom, including the shower, toilet, sink and tub.

services.title: Kitchen Plumbing
services.text: Installation and maintenance of kitchen and utility plumbing, including the sink, dishwasher and laundry machine.

services.title: Repipes
services.text: Repiping for homes whose supply lines have reached the end of their service life.

services.title: Commercial Plumbing
services.text: From installing and repairing plumbing systems to maintaining commercial water heaters and addressing complex drain issues, our team keeps your operations running.
points: Work planned to minimise disruption to your business
Available 24/7 so your business keeps serving its customers
Repiping water and sewer lines with pipe-bursting technology, through two small access holes
Commercial water heaters installed, and building drains cleaned of debris and odours

services.title: Backflow Testing and Repair
services.text: Backflow testing and repair, along with repair of your backup pump.

groups.title: Cooling (A/C)
groups.summary: AC repair, maintenance and installation, plus thermostats, mini splits and indoor air quality.
groups.intro: Nothing leaves you with greater peace of mind like routine maintenance and a tune-up from a professional to ensure that your AC is working properly. Our fully trained, licensed and insured HVAC contractors service any and all units, whether you need installation, maintenance or repair.
groups.imageAlt: A technician going over the outdoor air conditioning unit with a homeowner

services.title: Air Conditioning Repair
services.text: A malfunctioning air conditioner will leave you exposed when extreme weather conditions strike. Our professional and speedy repair service deals with the common issues.

services.title: Air Conditioning Maintenance
services.text: Regular preventive maintenance for your HVAC system, making it more efficient and extending its service life.
points: Check the drain line for blockages
Ascertain that the electrical system is in proper working condition

services.title: Air Conditioning Installation
services.text: Whether you are installing a central air conditioner in a new home or replacing an old unit, we know that each home is different, so we offer installation care and maintenance that keeps your conditioner efficient and reliable.
points: It has consistently failed to keep your home cool
It has been operational for 10-15 years
It is no longer functioning efficiently
You have to schedule frequent AC repairs

services.title: Ductless Mini Splits
services.text: A ductless mini-split system cools your home without ductwork, using blower units that distribute heated or cooled air directly into the rooms.
points: Install, repair, replace and tune up
Energy-efficient cooling for the summer heat

services.title: Thermostat
services.text: The thermostat is the central brain of your heating and cooling system, and it should always be accurate to keep your home comfortable and energy efficient.

services.title: Indoor Air Quality
services.text: A tightly insulated home traps allergens such as smoke and dust in couches, bedding and carpeting, which can exacerbate allergies and make the house stuffy.
points: Indoor air quality testing and measurement
A better air filter fitted to your HVAC system, or a thorough duct cleaning
Humidity, dust, ventilation and pet dander all assessed

services.title: Commercial Cooling
services.text: Commercial AC repair, installation, maintenance and thermostat service, sized and fit to the demands of your business so your building stays comfortable year-round.
points: Refrigerant problems, short cycling and dirty filters diagnosed
Comprehensive maintenance plans for commercial units
A new unit lowers energy bills and improves indoor air quality

groups.title: Heating
groups.summary: Furnace and heater repair, replacement and maintenance, heat pumps and boilers.
groups.intro: We will help get you through the cold winter months with ease. Heaters can break down at any time of year, but when it is cold outside and your home is freezing you need someone on call who can come out right away. Our heating specialists are licensed plumbers and heating repair professionals, and we offer 24/7 emergency service.
groups.imageAlt: An outdoor heat pump unit standing on the lawn beside a house

services.title: Heater & Furnace Repair
services.text: If your heater is broken, our team of experts can help you get it fixed quickly and efficiently. We have licensed plumbers and heating specialists who know how to handle any heating or furnace problem.
points: We work with you to find the best solution for your needs

services.title: Heater & Furnace Replacement
services.text: If you are in the market for a new heater, there are a variety of different heaters to choose from. We will work with you to figure out what size and type is best for your home, and then take care of the installation.
points: Sized and matched to your home
Installed before the next cold season

services.title: Heater Maintenance
services.text: Regular maintenance catches problems with your heater before they turn into bigger issues, and it keeps the system running efficiently, which can save you money on your energy bill.

services.title: Heat Pump Services
services.text: Heat pump systems installed, repaired and maintained for homes that heat and cool from one system.

services.title: Boilers
services.text: Boiler service and repair by technicians who are licensed plumbers as well as heating professionals.

services.title: Commercial Heating
services.text: Commercial heating installation, maintenance, troubleshooting and emergency repair, so your employees and customers stay comfortable through a cold snap.

groups.title: Emergency Services
groups.summary: Available 24 hours a day, 7 days a week, with no extra charge for nights, weekends or holidays.
groups.intro: We are available 24 hours a day, 7 days a week. We are a team of licensed, insured technicians, and no matter the time of day, if you call us in the middle of the night a trustworthy plumber or HVAC technician will be at your door. We know emergency plumbing, heating and cooling issues are stressful, so we charge by the job and not by the time.
groups.imageAlt: A run of metal pipes in a mechanical room

services.title: Emergency Plumbing
services.text: Water leaks, frozen pipes and blocked toilets are the calls we take most often, and leaks that are not properly addressed only worsen the damage.
points: Flooding attended to as soon as possible

services.title: Emergency Cooling
services.text: An air conditioner that is not blowing cold air, or a thermostat that is not working, leaves your system running inefficiently and the house uncomfortable.

services.title: Emergency Heating
services.text: A gas leak is one of the most dangerous things your heating system can experience, and it needs a professional as quickly as possible.

services.title: Emergency Drain Cleaning
services.text: A drain that backs up usually has an underlying issue, and we look to resolve it rather than clear it and leave.

services.title: Emergency Commercial Plumbing
services.text: Emergency plumbing and HVAC repairs for commercial properties, with the skills and tools for a small repair or a large-scale problem.

about.title: Your home town professional.
text: 1-800-Plumber +Air is located in Pearland, TX and is focused on being the BEST. It is not about being better than everyone else; instead our focus is on providing you with the fast, dependable plumbing and emergency services when you need it most. Our goal is to give you the BEST experience you have ever received from a service based business.

In 1999 the 1-800-PLUMBER name and phone number was secured, leading to the well-known "Our Name is Our Number!" slogan. In 2010 Mark Collins joined the brand as a franchisee, and in April 2015 they purchased the 1-800-PLUMBER brand and created the foundation needed to grow it into a household name throughout the country.
Our goal is simply to be the BEST. When we finish a job, we want our customers to say, Wow, that was the BEST experience I have ever had. - Mark and Mike Collins

The 1-800-Plumber +Air team has the expertise to meet your needs with an easy to remember name and phone number, so call us today for help with all your Pearland home or business plumbing, drain cleaning, and heating and cooling needs.
about.imageAlt: A technician talking a homeowner through the work at her bathroom sink

values.title: 24/7 availability
values.text: We work nights and weekends, and we are always available, 24/7.

values.title: No surprise costs
values.text: Prices by the job, not by the hour, with no price surprises at the end of a job.

values.title: On time
values.text: Committed to arriving on time, and we call to confirm the arrival time.

faqs.q: Are you available outside business hours?
faqs.a: Yes. We are available 24 hours a day, 7 days a week, and we do not up-charge services for nights, weekends or holidays.
Prices are by the job, not by the hour, and there are no price surprises at the end of a job. We can also answer questions about costs, licensing and how long a job will take before we start.

faqs.q: When should I replace my air conditioner rather than repair it?
faqs.a: We recommend replacement if it has consistently failed to keep your home cool, it has been operational for 10 to 15 years, it is no longer efficient, or you have to schedule frequent repairs.

Water leaks, frozen or burst pipes, blocked toilets, a gas leak, a thermostat that is not working and an air conditioner that is not blowing cold air are the calls we see most. If you are experiencing flooding, contact us as soon as possible.
Select the day and time you would prefer and we will contact you to confirm the appointment. You can also call us directly at (281) 412-4284.
All work is guaranteed, and we will never sell a customer something that is not needed.
